description: This file defines the Adapter interface for mapping objects of type T to Adaptable and vice versa within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: An interface for mapping objects of type T to Adaptable and vice versa, supporting various operations like getting supported groups, channels, criteria, actions, and response capabilities.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to its corresponding type T.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Default method that maps type T to an Adaptable using the TWIN channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Maps type T to an Adaptable using a specified channel.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of groups supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of channels supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions supported by this adapter.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions supported by this adapter; defaults to empty set.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is for responses.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates whether a subject in the topic is required; defaults to false.
